caption: The video captures an ongoing ground fire consuming a strip of dry vegetation beside a line of bare trees. Active orange flames flicker and reshape themselves along the blackened edge, rising and falling in height. A dense white-gray smoke cloud billows upward on the right, partly obscuring distant trees and buildings, with occasional orange glow visible through the haze. The burning fringe along the left side of the charred strip appears brighter and more continuous. A person in a yellow jacket stands near the tree line, while a second figure in dark clothing becomes visible at the far left edge. The background and the pink marker drift slowly rightward, indicating a gradual shift of viewpoint. Smoke density and shape change continuously throughout. The flames remain smoldering and active without any visible conclusion.
